fields.name: remaining_targets
fields.description: An ordered list of [y, x] container locations for requested pickups not yet completed. At the first decision, identify the container initially covering each requested cube, follow its identity through the entire demonstration, and list its final location in the order specified by the goal. Follow continuous motion through swaps, not the original cube locations or the sorted order of detections; one exchange switches identities and two exchanges restore them. Ignore extra containers unless they cover a requested cube. Initialization for these episodes is: episode 14 [[106, 150]]; episode 28 [[84, 90], [92, 133]]; episode 53 [[80, 117], [121, 102]]; episode 80 [[105, 122], [73, 128]]; episode 90 [[124, 101]]. At the decision immediately following a successful requested pickup, remove the first entry. Do not remove an entry merely because a pickup is selected at the current decision. Putting a container down leaves the list unchanged. Thus, at steps 2 and 3 of each two-target episode, the list contains only the second target. Locations identify containers rather than requiring exact pixel agreement. e.g. [[121, 102]]
